dialogues.en: "Waaaah... that was a good, long rest."
dialogues.text: "Waaaah... that was a good, long rest."

dialogues.jp: ベッドの上で上体を起こし、大きく伸びをする。
dialogues.en: I get up from my bed and stretch.
dialogues.text: I get up from my bed and stretch.

dialogues.jp:
元気ハツラツな気分でベッドから起き上がると、
私服に着替え、部屋のドアを開ける。
dialogues.en:
I energetically jump off the bed, change into some casual
clothes, and head out of my room.
dialogues.text:
I energetically jump off the bed, change into some casual
clothes, and head out of my room.

dialogues.jp: 「そういえば音夢は起きたかな？」
dialogues.en: "Speaking of which, has Nemu woken up already?"
dialogues.text: "Speaking of which, has Nemu woken up already?"

dialogues.jp:
上の部屋にはいなかったが、下の階を見てまわっ
ても音夢の姿はなかった。
dialogues.en:
She's not in her room above mine, and I don't see her figure
downstairs either.
dialogues.text:
She's not in her room above mine, and I don't see her figure
downstairs either.

dialogues.jp:
テーブルの上に小さなピンク色のメモ用紙が置
いてある。
dialogues.en: On the table lay a small pink-coloured piece of memo paper.
dialogues.text: On the table lay a small pink-coloured piece of memo paper.

dialogues.jp:
『兄さんへ。もうぜんぜん大丈夫なので、美春
　と遊びに行ってきます』
dialogues.en: "Brother. I'm feeling fine now, so I went to meet Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Brother. I'm feeling fine now, so I went to meet Miharu."

dialogues.jp:
病み上がりなんだから、じっとしていればいい
のに……。
dialogues.en:
She should be resting fully during the convalescence
period...
dialogues.text:
She should be resting fully during the convalescence
period...

dialogues.jp:
（まあ、このぶんなら、ホントに身体のほうは
　良くなったんだろう）
dialogues.en:
(Well, I guess I should be happy enough that she's already
recovering so quickly.)
dialogues.text:
(Well, I guess I should be happy enough that she's already
recovering so quickly.)

dialogues.jp: 「俺も飯を食うついでに、散歩でもするか……」
財布をポケットにいれ、玄関へと向かう。
dialogues.en: Putting my wallet in my pocket, I head for the door.
dialogues.text: Putting my wallet in my pocket, I head for the door.

dialogues.jp:
目が覚め、居間に行くと、音夢の書き置きがテー
ブルにあった。
dialogues.en:
After waking up and going to the living room, I found Nemu's
note on the table.
dialogues.text:
After waking up and going to the living room, I found Nemu's
note on the table.

dialogues.jp:
体調が良くなったから、美春と遊びに行くらし
い。やれやれ、病み上がりのくせに……。
dialogues.en:
Although her condition hasn't fully healed yet, she still
went to Miharu's. Sigh, she really doesn't care about the
convalescence period...
dialogues.text:
Although her condition hasn't fully healed yet, she still
went to Miharu's. Sigh, she really doesn't care about the
convalescence period...
